remarks: Single-story home on a large, flat lot with beautiful mountain views and ample RV parking! The interior features 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, vaulted ceilings, and built-in shelving that adds character and functionality. The family room offers a fireplace, while the formal living and dining room combination provides additional space for entertaining. Outside, the spacious lot offers room for recreational vehicles, extra parking, and a variety of outdoor possibilities. A great opportunity to enjoy single-level living with scenic surroundings and a versatile property. Come see this one today!
